verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5080 is a graphics card. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in MCP servers is not a fair axis for a GPU product. Nothing in the evidence shows the product (including the bundled G-Assist assistant) ships MCP client support, so the exception that would make the axis apply is not triggered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
